missions.description: As the civilization with the biggest impact on Aelantir, we will inevitably become the leading trading power of the region. Indeed, we will make sure of that.
missions.name: Trading Hub

missions.description: Having stabilized our country, it is time to implement profound reforms. To ensure the power and stability of Aelnar in perpetuity, we have to form a government with the capability and authority to make swift decisions. We need a Supreme Ruler, a King!
missions.name: Adapt the Government

missions.description: With our army operational, it is time to rethink our naval doctrine. Simply defending our coast is no longer enough. We need to strive for more. Our navy has to become the uncontested ruler of the oceans of the world, ready to repel any invaders before they can even set foot on our lands.
missions.name: The Teal Armada

missions.description: The time to shape our destiny has finally come.
missions.name: The Age of Reclamation

missions.description: Noruin is our homeland, and the starting point for all Aelnari to go forth and prosper. We must ensure our internal affairs are strong enough to support their efforts so that they will not crumble like the ruins our homes are built in.
missions.name: Rebuild Noruin

missions.description:
The AIA's operations have officially commenced. Its responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 
Monitoring suspicious communications among the civilian population 
Covert operations within and outside of Aelnar's borders 
Serving as commissars to ensure high morale and loyalty among our armed forces 
Suppression of dissident activities and arrests of suspect persons 

-Ecloir Elvacin, Ecloir Aelnare
missions.name: AIA

missions.description: After our recent migration, all aspects of the national economy must be revisited and revised. Hopefully we can stabilize our cashflow and rapidly adapt to our new environment.
missions.name: Revitalize the Economy

missions.description: With the arrival of the final wave of settlers, the rapidly growing population of our new home is placing a heavy toll on our administration. We need to stabilize the situation before expanding further.
missions.name: Stabilize the Country

missions.description: The sea is no longer our bulwark against any invader. War will now be fought on our soil, not on our coast. To win the battles to come, we need to rethink our military organization.
missions.name: New Elven Legions

missions.description: Dha Tchathil, the Two Black Towers, has become nearly as iconic a sight within the capital as Arca Ore. It is a gaudy display of absolute power, the headquarters of the AIA and workplace of thousands of agents in the capital alone. With its construction finished, we can soon start operating the AIA at full capacity.
missions.name: Dha Tchathil

missions.description: It's finally time. Our Grand Armada is ready to set sail, and write the final chapter of our Cannorian history. Some fools want to stay on Venáil, but who are we to stop them?
missions.name: A New Beginning

missions.description: Aelnar has many enemies, in Aelantir and beyond. The exterior branch of the AIA will ensure that all of their movements are known about, so that no external threat may endanger our homeland's stability.
missions.name: Exterior Branch

missions.description: The Interior branch of the AIA will deal with the ever-present threat of rebellion and dissent. Most Elves alive remember what happens when you let rebellious attitudes fester and grow. We cannot allow something like that to happen again. The AIA will keep a close watch on all suspect persons using spies and scrying magic, to ensure that any potential uprisings are quashed before they can become a serious threat to stability.
missions.name: Interior Branch

strings.A21_legion_effect: Spends 100 military power, adds venail_legion for 14600 days and calls venail.14; the event outcome is not expanded.
strings.A21_legion_trigger: Requires 100 military power; ai=no requires army_size 40 and the else branch requires 20. Branch semantics remain unverified.
strings.A21_new_beginning_effect: Transfers treasury and manpower from every_subject_country limited to A21 colonial nations through currency_effect, inherits those subjects, and uses reduce_stability_or_adm_power. Both branches move the capital, conditionally change trade goods, add or upgrade a centre of trade, and rename the capital and province Aelnar; only the venail_capital branch changes culture and religion. Helpers remain unexpanded. It calls venail.20 in hidden_effect/88/owner and venail.105 in the current-country hidden_effect.
strings.A21_new_beginning_trigger: Requires no venail_immigration_third_step; requires an A21 colonial subject with 15 cities and its capital in colonial_noruin; must be at peace. Eligibility remains complex_unverified.
strings.A21_potential: Available to the native Venail A21 mission groups; exact group potential is preserved in the cited source block.
strings.A21_rekindling_effect: Calls venail.8 and sets the elven_rekindling flag. The event option has no effect; the formation decision separately executes the Tag change.
strings.A21_rekindling_trigger: Requires A21_renovate_political_system, A21_trading_hub and A21_the_teal_armada. Its own trigger is always=yes, which does not remove those prerequisites.
strings.A21_renovate_effect: Spends 100 of each power type, changes government to monarchy and calls venail.13; the event outcome is not expanded.
strings.A21_renovate_trigger: Requires at least 100 administrative, diplomatic and military power, in addition to the recorded direct prerequisite.
strings.A21_revitalize_effect: Spends 100 administrative power; its AI=yes branch spends 150 treasury and the other branch 500, adds venail_economic_boom for 14600 days, removes sold_venail_rights and calls venail.10. Branch semantics remain unverified.
strings.A21_revitalize_trigger: Requires 100 administrative power. The trigger requires AI with was_player=no to have 150 treasury; every other case requires 500. This differs from the effect branch and remains complex_unverified.
strings.A21_stabilize_effect: Adds 20 prestige, adds venail_autonomy for 14600 days and calls venail.12; the event outcome is not expanded.
strings.A21_stabilize_trigger: The ai=no branch requires stability 3; the else branch is always=yes. Branch semantics remain unverified.
strings.A21_teal_effect: Spends 100 diplomatic power, adds a modifier for 14600 days and calls venail.15; the event outcome is not expanded.
strings.A21_teal_trigger: Requires at least 100 diplomatic power. Players need 10 heavy ships or navy-size ratio 0.95; AI needs 5 heavy ships. Branch semantics remain unverified.
strings.A21_trading_hub_effect: Spends the applicable 150 or 500 treasury and 100 diplomatic power with Dharma or 200 without it; adds a modifier for 14600 days and calls venail.11. The event outcome is not expanded.
strings.A21_trading_hub_trigger: AI requires 150 treasury and players 500. With Dharma, requires 100 diplomatic power and a level 2 trade centre for AI or level 3 for players; without Dharma, requires 200 diplomatic power. Branches remain unverified.
strings.Z43_aia_effect: Spends 200 of each power type and one year of income, then calls aelnar.68; the event outcome is not expanded.
strings.Z43_aia_trigger: Requires at least 200 of each power type, treasury equal to one year of income and peace, in addition to its prerequisite and both Calasandur group flags.
strings.Z43_calasandur_potential: Requires Z43 plus both Calasandur rule flags; this conditional group is not treated as universally available.
strings.Z43_common_potential: Available when the country tag is Z43; this is the common Z43 group scope.
strings.Z43_dha_effect: Spends years_of_income 0.5 and adds the permanent capital modifier aelnar_dha_thathil with duration -1.
strings.Z43_dha_trigger: Requires the capital not to have either aelnar_dha_tchathil_construction_exterior or aelnar_dha_tchathil_construction_interior, and years_of_income 0.5. Prerequisites and group flags remain separate conditions.
strings.Z43_exterior_branch_effect: Deducts 350 dip_power and applies aelnar_dha_tchathil_construction_exterior to capital_scope for 1825 days; downstream remains complex_unverified.
strings.Z43_exterior_branch_trigger: Requires 350 dip_power; the aelnar_5_calasandur_2 group also requires rianvisa_calasandur_rule and rianvisa_calasandur_rule_2.
strings.Z43_interior_branch_effect: Deducts 350 adm_power and applies aelnar_dha_tchathil_construction_interior to capital_scope for 1825 days; downstream remains complex_unverified.
strings.Z43_interior_branch_trigger: Requires 350 adm_power; the aelnar_4_calasandur_2 group also requires rianvisa_calasandur_rule and rianvisa_calasandur_rule_2.
strings.Z43_rebuild_effect: Reduces inflation by 3 and adds the growing-economy modifier for 10950 days; modifier values are not inferred.
strings.Z43_rebuild_trigger: Players need 5 Noruin provinces for each of the trade, tax and production building checks separately; these need not be the same 5 provinces. The AI branch is always=yes. Building-trigger semantics remain unverified.
